development_and_interruption_policy: Development trials are retained separately under results/navigation.
interrupted_attempt: The first multi-trial execution ended before shifted_start seed 2 finished. Its partial sensor log is retained. The same seed completed successfully as retry1-002.
population: Six conditions, seeds 0..2 each; this is not a guarantee for arbitrary rooms or hardware.
closed_loop_controls: No simulator base pose or obstacle ground truth is used for feedback or planning.
